work_product: Do not touch Jellyfin config, Jellyfin DB, or media files. Build a staging-only cleanup lane that scans filenames and existing sidecars into a report, ranks likely matches, and emits proposed rename/metadata actions for human review. Tool takeaways: tinyMediaManager for media-center metadata, MusicBrainz Picard for music, FileBot/beets as preview engines only until the current mess is inventoried.
